description: This file defines classes and methods for managing manufacturing operations, workcenter lines, production orders, and related workflows in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, specifically for 'mrp_operations'. It includes models for stock moves, workcenter lines, production, and operation codes, with methods for state transitions, scheduling, and operation validation.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extends 'stock.move' with a one2many relation to child moves and a custom copy method.

classes.name: mrp_production_workcenter_line
classes.description: Represents a workcenter line in manufacturing, with methods for scheduling, state transitions, and date calculations.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Extends 'mrp.production' with additional scheduling, planning, and workflow management methods.

classes.name: mrp_operations_operation_code
classes.description: Defines operation codes with start/stop statuses for manufacturing operations.

classes.name: mrp_operations_operation
classes.description: Represents manufacturing operations linked to production, with methods for validation, delay calculation, and workflow control.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides the copy method to reset 'move_dest_id_lines' when duplicating a stock move.

methods.name: _get_date_date
methods.description: Computes the start date in 'date' format from 'date_start'.

methods.name: _get_date_end
methods.description: Computes the end date based on 'date_planned' and timesheet intervals.

methods.name: modify_production_order_state
methods.description: Handles state transitions for production workcenter lines, triggering workflows.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to update 'date_start' based on 'date_planned'.

methods.name: action_draft
methods.description: Sets the workcenter line state to 'draft'.

methods.name: action_start_working
methods.description: Starts work on the line, updating state and start date.

methods.name: action_done
methods.description: Marks the workcenter line as done, calculates delay, and updates end date.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the workcenter line.

methods.name: action_pause
methods.description: Pauses the workcenter line.

methods.name: action_resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused workcenter line.

methods.name: _production_date_end
methods.description: Calculates the latest end date among workcenter lines.

methods.name: action_production_end
methods.description: Ends production, marking all workcenter lines as done.

methods.name: action_in_production
methods.description: Marks production as in progress, starting all workcenter lines.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels production and associated workcenter lines.

methods.name: _compute_planned_workcenter
methods.description: Recomputes planned dates for workcenter lines based on sequence and dependencies.

methods.name: _move_pass
methods.description: Adjusts start dates of production orders that are behind schedule.

methods.name: _move_futur
methods.description: Adjusts start dates of production orders scheduled in the future.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to trigger planned date recalculations and handle schedule shifts.

methods.name: action_compute
methods.description: Computes planning and updates workcenter schedule.

methods.name: calc_delay
methods.description: Calculates delay based on operation start/stop codes and timestamps.

methods.name: check_operation
methods.description: Validates operation state transitions based on codes and current status.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new operation, updating related workcenter lines and workflows.
